name: Marvin the Moose's Bubble Gum Adventure
author: Newbiegamer810
description: CONTROLS: Arrow keys for movement. Space bar to blow a bubble, release space bar to pop bubble and kill enemies when they are close enough. Some enemies might require more than one popped bubble to kill. Win by killing all the enemies. SOURCES: Sound effects: freesound.org.   Game Soundtrack: Final Fantasy Dimensions original soundtrack/song: Prelude(legends edition)/artist: Nobuo Uematsu. I made all the art using pixilart.com.
